display_long_description:
Escape the hustle and bustle of daily life and immerse yourself in the relaxing world of Farmy. This isn't just a farming game; it’s a vibrant, living world where you are the architect of your own agricultural empire, designed specifically for the Meta Quest.

Build Your Dream Farm Start with a small plot of land and turn it into a flourishing business. Plant and harvest a wide variety of crops, from golden corn fields to ripe tomatoes and cabbages. Watch your farm come alive as you water your plants and prepare for the harvest season.

Raise & Care for Animals A farm isn't complete without its animals! Build cozy pens for your cows, sheep, and chickens. Feed them, care for them, and collect valuable resources like milk, wool, and eggs. The happier your animals are, the more your farm thrives.

Drive & Explore Why walk when you can drive? Jump into the driver's seat of your trusty farm truck. Navigate through your fields, transport goods efficiently, and experience the satisfaction of mechanized farming in VR.

Trade & Expand Set up your own market stalls and sell your fresh goods directly to eager customers visiting your farm. Manage your economy, reinvest your profits to unlock new tools, upgrade your buildings, and expand your territory to become the ultimate farming tycoon.

Features:

Immersive VR Gameplay: Interact with your farm using your own hands.

Relaxing Atmosphere: Enjoy colorful, low-poly graphics and soothing environments.

Tycoon Mechanics: Manage resources,
